# Reflextry

> Free online brain training platform — reaction time tests, memory games, speed challenges, accuracy tools, and FPS aim trainers. The human benchmark alternative built for Gen Z.

Reflextry offers 45+ scientifically-inspired cognitive tests and games across five categories: Reflex, Memory, Speed, Accuracy, and Gaming. All tests are free, require no login, and run instantly in any browser.

## Reflex Tests

- [Reaction Time Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/reaction): Measure visual reaction time in milliseconds. Click as fast as you can when the screen changes color.
- [Audio Reaction Time Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sound): Measure auditory reaction speed. React to sound cues as fast as possible.
- [Grid Shot Aim Trainer](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/grid): Boost mouse accuracy and click precision with rapid grid target shooting.
- [Peripheral Vision Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/peripheral): Test wide-field visual awareness by spotting targets in your peripheral vision.
- [Directional Reflex Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/direction): Press the correct arrow key as fast as you can to train decision-making speed.
- [Multi-Stimulus Reaction Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/multi-stimulus): Process multiple stimuli and respond selectively to train cognitive reaction speed.
- [Sequence Reaction Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sequence-reaction): Watch a sequence of lights and click them in order as fast as possible.
- [Whack-a-Mole Reflex Game](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/whack-a-mole): Tap moles as they pop up to train reflexes and hand-eye coordination.
- [Color Switch Reflex Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/color-switch): React to color flashes quickly to train selective attention and cognitive processing.
- [Time Perception Test](https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/time-perception): Test your internal clock by holding a button for exactly the target duration.

## Memory Tests

- [Sequence Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/sequence): Repeat increasingly long patterns to train working memory and sequence recall.
- [Number Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/number): Memorize and recall number sequences to measure digit span and working memory.
- [Visual Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/visual): Recall grid patterns to test spatial awareness and visual short-term memory.
- [Stroop Effect Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/color): Test cognitive flexibility and attention with the classic Stroop color-word task.
- [Shape Rush](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/shape): Find target shapes as fast as possible to train visual discrimination and processing speed.
- [Symbol Pairs Memory Game](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/symbol): Match symbol pairs to improve concentration and visual spatial memory.
- [Word Recall Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/word-recall): Remember and recall word lists to train verbal memory and cognitive retention.
- [Card Match Memory Game](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/card-match): Classic pairs-matching card game to train pattern recognition and spatial memory.
- [Chimp Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/chimp-test): The famous chimpanzee memory test. Memorize numbers and click them in ascending order.
- [Verbal Memory Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/verbal-memory): Identify whether words are new or previously seen to test verbal recognition memory.
- [Multiple Object Tracking Test](https://www.reflextry.com/memory/object-tracking): Track moving targets among distractors to test visual attention and tracking ability.

## Speed Tests

- [CPS Test — Clicks Per Second](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/click): Measure mouse clicking speed in clicks per second. Supports jitter, butterfly, and drag clicking.
- [Typing Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/typing): Measure typing speed in WPM and accuracy with real paragraphs.
- [Speed Math Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/math): Solve arithmetic problems rapidly to improve mental math fluency and calculation speed.
- [Word Accuracy Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/words): Type exact words quickly to boost keyboard precision and reduce typing errors.
- [Grid Selection Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/grid): Find and select highlighted cells to train visual search speed and mouse accuracy.
- [Number Rush Speed Test](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/number-rush): Find and click numbers in ascending order as fast as possible to train visual scanning.
- [Quick Sort Speed Game](https://www.reflextry.com/speed/quick-sort): Sort items into correct categories before time runs out to train decision-making speed.

## Accuracy Tests

- [Precision Clicking Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/precision-click): Click small targets accurately to train hand-eye coordination and mouse control.
- [Pattern Matching Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/pattern-matching): Match complex visual patterns to train attention to detail and visual precision.
- [Data Entry Accuracy Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/data): Type complex alphanumeric codes accurately to measure data entry precision.
- [Image Recognition Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/image-recognition): Spot differences and identify matches to train observation and visual accuracy.
- [Angle Estimation Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/angle-estimation): Estimate angles accurately to test spatial awareness and visual precision.
- [Color Match Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-match): Match exact color shades to train visual discrimination and color accuracy.
- [Color Blindness Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-blindness): Identify hidden numbers in Ishihara-style dot plates to check color vision.
- [Mental Rotation Test](https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/mental-rotation): Determine if rotated 3D objects are the same or mirrored to test spatial intelligence.

## Gaming & Aim Training

- [Aim Trainer Pro](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/aim): Improve tracking, flicking, and mouse precision with moving-target aim training for FPS games.
- [RPG Reaction — Block & Parry](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/reaction): Block incoming RPG-style attacks to train timing and defensive reflexes.
- [Endless Dodge](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/endless-dodge): Dodge projectiles for as long as possible to test evasion reflexes and spatial awareness.
- [Infinite Stroop Drop](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/stroop-drop): Click the font color of falling text to train impulse control and cognitive reflection.
- [Target Tracking](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/target-tracking): Track an erratic moving target with your mouse to improve continuous aim accuracy.
- [Flick Shot Aim Trainer](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/flick-shot): Practice quick flick shots to improve muscle memory and flicking accuracy for FPS games.
- [Rhythm Tap Game](https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/rhythm-tap): Tap to the beat to test rhythmic timing and audio-visual coordination.
